about: Hard-site eval: government and bank help pages, deep, inconsistent and often behind bot protection. Each case starts at its site's home page. A run succeeds when the navigator reports Reached and the final URL or title contains one of the keywords (and none of `avoid`). When the navigator hands back for text, the eval types the case's `query` and Enter, as the calling agent would, up to twice. Run with `aibrowse eval navigator --suite evals/hard-sites.json`.
